# How Long Does House Cleaning Take? (Cape Town Guide)

Most people asking **how long house cleaning takes** are really asking whether they can still do school pickup, host a call, or meet a handover window. The honest answer is a **range**: bedrooms and bathrooms multiply minutes faster than brochure square metres—and **deep** work stretches time in kitchens and wet rooms first.

This article is the **timing layer** in your Shalean cluster. Pair it with [**which tier to book**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/deep-vs-standard-cleaning-which-to-book-cape-town) (decision), [**what is included in deep cleaning**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/whats-included-in-deep-cleaning-cape-town) (scope), and [**same-day cleaning**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/same-day-cleaning-cape-town) (urgency). Timing is not a substitute for scope—your booking ticks still define the job.

---

## Quick answer: how long does house cleaning take?

For a typical **fair-baseline** home, **standard** cleaning often lands in a **shorter** band than **deep** cleaning for the **same** bedroom and bathroom count—because deep buys extra dwell on edges, kitchens, and baths. **Clutter, pets, access friction, and first-time resets** push either tier longer. Use the table below as a **planning heuristic**, then confirm in the booking flow.

---

## Typical cleaning time by property type (indicative)

**Crew-hours** means one cleaner for one hour (two cleaners for one hour = two crew-hours). Figures are **not quotes**—add-ons, soil level, and layout move real schedules.

| Property type (typical layout) | Standard cleaning (common band) | Deep cleaning (common band) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Studio / 1-bed apartment** | Often about **1.5–3** crew-hours | Often about **2.5–4.5** crew-hours |
| **2-bedroom apartment** | Often about **2–4** crew-hours | Often about **3.5–6** crew-hours |
| **3-bedroom house** (2 baths) | Often about **3–5** crew-hours | Often about **5–8+** crew-hours |
| **4-bedroom+** or extra wet rooms | Add time roughly in line with extra baths and kitchen load | Deep often **materially longer** than standard |

**First visit after a long gap** often behaves closer to the **deep** column even if you select standard—because reset work shows up as extra minutes.

---

## What usually slows cleaning down?

These factors routinely add time in Cape Town jobs—good notes prevent surprises:

- **Clutter on surfaces and floors** (toys, paperwork, dishes) — cleaning time is not decluttering time
- **Pets** — hair, dander, and cautious movement around animals
- **Parking and access** — Sea Point kerbs, estate security, lifts, and vague buzzer notes cost minutes fast
- **Post-renovation fine dust** — not the same as a maintenance deep; may need scoped builder-style cleaning
- **Children’s rooms** — small objects, floor coverage, and “reset” expectations
- **No prior maintenance** — when standard has been skipped for months, the first professional visit stretches
- **Heavy kitchen grease or bathroom limescale** — wet rooms eat the clock before living areas get attention
- **Load-shedding or access windows** — compressed time on site can force rescheduling if access fails

The fix is the same as for [**same-day routing**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/same-day-cleaning-cape-town): **accurate room counts, realistic add-ons, and honest notes** before checkout.

---

## Standard vs deep: why deep almost always runs longer

Standard keeps a fair baseline on a maintenance checklist. Deep pulls film and edges back to baseline so standard can work again—see [**what is included in deep cleaning**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/whats-included-in-deep-cleaning-cape-town). Same home, same beds and baths: expect **deep** to sit **meaningfully** above standard in crew-hours until the home is easy to maintain again.

---

## Apartments vs houses in Cape Town (practical note)

Apartments can look “smaller” yet still carry **dense** soil in kitchens and baths—especially coastal rentals. Houses spread dust across more skirting and entrances; **Constantia**-style garden dust and **Claremont** school-week traffic do not change chemistry, but they do change **how fast** a team can move between rooms without rushing wet areas.

---

## How to plan your day around the visit

- Book **morning** starts if you need the home usable by afternoon
- Ask how **multi-cleaner** teams change wall-clock time (more hands, shorter on-site window when offered)
- If you are time-boxed, **reduce scope** (defer optional rooms) rather than asking for unsafe rushing

---

## Pricing and timing together

Longer visits cost more because labour increases—compare **itemised totals**, not vibes. Use [**cleaning prices in Cape Town**](https://shalean.co.za/cleaning-prices-cape-town) for band context, then open [**standard**](https://shalean.co.za/services/standard-cleaning-cape-town) or [**deep**](https://shalean.co.za/services/deep-cleaning-cape-town) to see numbers for your exact selections.

Pick tier first ([**which to book**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/deep-vs-standard-cleaning-which-to-book-cape-town)), match scope ([**what is included in deep cleaning**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/whats-included-in-deep-cleaning-cape-town)), then start a booking to see **real** calendar fit—including [**same-day**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/same-day-cleaning-cape-town) when routing allows.

---

## Frequently asked questions

### How long does a standard clean take for a 2-bedroom apartment?

Often roughly **2–4** crew-hours on a fair baseline; clutter, pets, or heavy kitchens push longer.

### How long does a deep clean take for the same apartment?

Often roughly **3.5–6** crew-hours depending on kitchens, baths, and add-ons like oven interior.

### Why was my clean shorter than a friend’s?

Different scope, soil level, layout, and add-ons change duration—compare line items, not gossip.

### Does deep cleaning always take twice as long as standard?

Not a fixed ratio, but deep is often **materially longer** on the same home until the baseline resets.

### Can cleaners finish faster if I am not home?

Sometimes access helps, but **rushing wet rooms** hurts quality—better to adjust scope than cut bathroom time unsafely.

### How do I book with a realistic window?

Enter accurate rooms and tier online; your quote reflects scope. If you are time-critical, read [**same-day cleaning**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/same-day-cleaning-cape-town) for routing realities.

---

## End CTA

Time is honest when scope is honest: book [**standard cleaning Cape Town**](https://shalean.co.za/services/standard-cleaning-cape-town) or [**deep cleaning Cape Town**](https://shalean.co.za/services/deep-cleaning-cape-town) with accurate details, check [**pricing**](https://shalean.co.za/cleaning-prices-cape-town), and confirm a window that matches your day—not a fantasy stopwatch.
